South Korean Football Association Apologizes Over Allegations of Sexual Services

South Korea's Football Association has issued an apology following media reports alleging that it provided "sexual services" to foreign referees. These alleged incidents occurred more than a decade ago, in relation to qualifiers for the 2014 World Cup and the 2012 London Olympic Games. South Korean broadcaster JTBC reported the allegations on Thursday.
